cues.en: Fifty milliseconds. That's how fast visitors judge your page's looks.
cues.ko: 0.05초. 방문자가 페이지 겉모습을 판단하는 시간이에요.

cues.en: Claude writes it. Higgsfield makes it real. Noa's envelope? Opens at the end.
cues.ko: Claude가 쓰고 Higgsfield가 현실로. 봉투는 마지막에 열어요.
cues.say: Claude writes it. Higgsfield makes it real. Noah's envelope? Opens at the end.

cues.en: Who's this for? Probably you.
cues.ko: 누구를 위한 거냐고요? 아마 당신이요.

cues.en: Agency? Your portfolio plays like a showreel, and books the call.
cues.ko: 에이전시라면? 포트폴리오가 쇼릴처럼 흐르고, 상담 예약까지.

cues.en: Online shop? Products spin, shine, and hop into the cart.
cues.ko: 쇼핑몰이라면? 제품이 돌고, 빛나고, 장바구니로 쏙.

cues.en: Local store? Hours, directions, booking: one tap from your page.
cues.ko: 매장이라면? 영업시간, 길 찾기, 예약까지 페이지에서 한 번에.

cues.en: Influencer? Your one link becomes a real shop window.
cues.ko: 인플루언서라면? 링크 하나가 제대로 된 쇼윈도가 돼요.

cues.en: Proof? Claude wrote it. Higgsfield hosts it.
cues.ko: 증거요? Claude가 쓰고, Higgsfield가 호스팅해요.

cues.en: Noa, your guide. Too cool for eye contact.
cues.ko: 가이드 노아예요. 너무 쿨해서 눈은 안 마주쳐요.
cues.say: Noah, your guide. Too cool for eye contact.

cues.en: StoryBrand's rule: your customer is the hero. Not your brand.
cues.ko: 스토리브랜드 원칙: 주인공은 브랜드가 아니라 고객이에요.
cues.say: Story Brand's rule: your customer is the hero. Not your brand.

cues.en: Claude drafts the story: their problem, you as guide, three steps, one button.
cues.ko: 이야기는 Claude가: 고객의 문제, 길잡이인 나, 3단계, 버튼 하나.

cues.en: Then make every scroll a scene change. Interactive pages hold people longer.
cues.ko: 스크롤마다 장면이 바뀌게. 인터랙티브 페이지는 더 오래 붙잡아요.

cues.en: My page? Hook. Proof. Action.
cues.ko: 제 페이지는? 훅, 증거, 행동.

cues.en: Noa, demoted from hero to guide. He's... coping.
cues.ko: 주인공에서 길잡이로 강등된 노아. 지금… 추스르는 중.
cues.say: Noah, demoted from hero to guide. He's... coping.

cues.en: Chin up, Noa. Guides just need one face.
cues.ko: 힘내, 노아. 길잡이는 얼굴 하나면 돼.
cues.say: Chin up, Noah. Guides just need one face.

cues.en: Ever generated three shots and gotten three different faces? Noa has.
cues.ko: 세 컷 뽑았더니 얼굴이 셋? 노아가 그랬어요.
cues.say: Ever generated three shots and gotten three different faces? Noah has.

cues.en: Blue Noa. Nerdy Noa. Spiky Noa. Who are these hamsters?
cues.ko: 파란 노아, 범생이 노아, 삐죽머리 노아. 너희 누구야?
cues.say: Blue Noah. Nerdy Noah. Spiky Noah. Who are these hamsters?

cues.en: One: a grey character sheet. Face close-up, body front and back.
cues.ko: 하나, 회색 배경 캐릭터 시트. 얼굴 클로즈업, 전신 앞·뒤.

cues.en: Two: Soul ID, for real faces. Twenty-plus photos, three to five minutes.
cues.ko: 둘, 실제 인물이면 Soul ID. 사진 20장 이상, 3~5분 학습.

cues.en: Three: reuse it in Kling or Seedance via Reference Element.
cues.ko: 셋, Reference Element로 Kling·Seedance 재사용.
cues.say: Three: reuse it in Kling or Seed dance via Reference Element.

cues.en: Four: lock outfit and hair. Five: references beat seeds.
cues.ko: 넷, 의상·헤어 고정. 다섯, 시드보다 레퍼런스.

cues.en: Same shades, same scarf. Higgsfield keeps the face. Now let's make him move.
cues.ko: 얼굴은 Higgsfield가 지키고, 이제 움직여 볼 차례!

cues.en: Attach the sheet to Seedance 2.5. Don't re-describe Noa.
cues.ko: 시트를 Seedance 2.5에 첨부. 노아를 다시 묘사하지 마세요.
cues.say: Attach the sheet to Seed dance two point five. Don't re-describe Noah.

cues.en: Claude writes the shot list: visual rule on top, sound rule last.
cues.ko: 샷 리스트는 Claude가: 맨 위엔 화면 규칙, 맨 끝엔 사운드 규칙.

cues.en: Each shot: action, framing, end point. Hard cut.
cues.ko: 샷마다 동작, 구도, 끝나는 지점. 그리고 하드 컷.

cues.en: A few takes later: same Noa, up to thirty seconds, with sound.
cues.ko: 몇 번 다시 뽑으면: 같은 노아, 최대 30초, 소리까지.
cues.say: A few takes later: same Noah, up to thirty seconds, with sound.

cues.en: Now, speed. Past three seconds, Google says 53% of mobile visits are abandoned.
cues.ko: 이제 속도. 구글: 3초를 넘기면 모바일 방문의 53%가 이탈해요.

cues.en: Then make every scroll move something. Reward the thumb; it keeps going.
cues.ko: 스크롤마다 뭔가 움직이게. 엄지에 보상을 주면 계속 내려가요.

cues.en: Your Seedance clip? Hero video. 85% tell Wyzowl a video convinced them to buy.
cues.ko: 히어로엔 Seedance 영상. 85%가 영상 보고 구매 결심(Wyzowl)
cues.say: Your Seed dance clip? Hero video. 85% tell Wyzowl a video convinced them to buy.

cues.en: Smooth motion? Claude Opus codes it. How do you think this video moves?
cues.ko: 모션은 Claude Opus가 코드로. 이 영상은 어떻게 움직일까요?

cues.en: Now, earn their trust.
cues.ko: 이제 신뢰를 얻을 차례예요.

cues.en: Expertise is the meal. Humor is the seasoning.
cues.ko: 전문성은 본 요리, 유머는 양념.

cues.en: Show your work; visible effort earns trust.
cues.ko: 과정을 보여 주세요. 보이는 노력이 신뢰가 돼요.

cues.en: Five reviews, not zero? Purchase likelihood up 270%.
cues.ko: 후기 0개보다 5개면? 구매 가능성 270% 상승.

cues.en: Oracle: 91% prefer funny brands; 72% would pick them over rivals.
cues.ko: 오라클 조사: 91%는 재밌는 브랜드 선호, 72%는 경쟁사 대신 선택.

cues.en: Rule: joke about the situation, never the customer, Uchal.
cues.ko: 규칙: 상황은 비틀어도, 고객은 놀리지 않기. 알았지, 우찰?
cues.say: Rule: joke about the situation, never the customer, Oo-chal.

cues.en: 'Noa's rendering, coffee number two.' Claude wrote that. Now, money.
cues.ko: ‘노아 렌더링 중, 커피 두 잔째.’ Claude 작품. 이제 돈 얘기.
cues.say: Noah's rendering, coffee number two. Claude wrote that. Now, money.

cues.en: Remember Noa's envelope? It all comes down to one button.
cues.ko: 노아의 봉투 기억나요? 결국 버튼 하나에 달렸어요.
cues.say: Remember Noah's envelope? It all comes down to one button.

cues.en: Revenue is visitors, times conversion, times order value.
cues.ko: 매출 = 방문자 × 전환율 × 객단가.

cues.en: Say conversion rises one point: 2.7 million won becomes 4.5.
cues.ko: 전환율이 1%p 오르면: 270만 원이 450만 원으로. (예시)

cues.en: That's the button. Tomorrow: Claude writes yours. One main, one 'maybe later.'
cues.ko: 그게 그 버튼. 내일은 Claude와 써 보세요: 메인 하나, ‘나중에’ 하나.

cues.en: Noa's cheeks? Already full.
cues.ko: 노아 볼주머니요? 벌써 꽉 찼어요.

cues.en: Next hero: your customer. See Noa's page live, then publish yours on Higgsfield.
cues.ko: 다음 주인공은 고객. 노아 페이지 보고, 내 것도 Higgsfield로!
cues.say: Next hero: your customer. See Noah's page live, then publish yours on Higgsfield.
